usageNotes: Use this to list all CIDR entries within a named IPSet scoped to a specific LXC container's firewall. The IPSet must already exist on the container; call the IPSet list endpoint first if you need to confirm the name. Each returned entry includes a digest — capture it before any subsequent add/remove operations to guard against concurrent modifications.

examples.summary: List all CIDRs in the 'trusted-mgmt' IPSet for LXC 110 on node pve1

tips: IPSet names must start with a letter and match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+; names like '10net' are invalid.
The 'nomatch' flag on an entry inverts that CIDR (acts as an exclusion within the set); check it before assuming all returned CIDRs are allow-listed.
This endpoint reads the container-level IPSet, which is separate from cluster-level IPSets defined under datacenter firewall — verify scope when troubleshooting rule mismatches.
The digest in each entry is per-entry, not per-set; use it with modification calls to prevent race conditions when multiple admins manage the same set.
